text: Kira: heads-up — compact playground token indicator is acting weird when a saved prompt is quick-inserted during streaming. it flashes a final value then disappears. Noah: reproduce in compact rail or full composer? Kira: compact rail. long streaming outputs (esp. formatted code) make it obvious. quick-insert triggers a finalize path and then the stream end clears the UI. Tess: sounds like a state race. we probably set finalCount and then run clear on stream-end. Ivy: a11y problem: aria-live updates are firing for each chunk. screen readers will read dozens of intermediate counts. bad UX. Kira: proposed UX: show a muted "live" token pulse (aria-hidden) updated visually but throttled. only reveal/announce the final count at completion. Noah: sketch markup: ~245 and Final: 245. also add 500ms visual throttle. Tess: agreed. add debounce on the finalize transition to avoid flip-flop if chunks arrive just after finalize. Ivy: also change Stop button accessible name from "Stop" to "Stop streaming response" for context. tooltip shows (Esc). keep visible label short but add offscreen accessible text. Kira: enqueue behavior question: current quick-insert cancels and drops partial output. i'd prefer queuing the insert and showing a toast "Insert queued 12; stop to apply" with Undo. Noah: queue+toast is least surprising. implementation: stash client-side and apply on next stop/regenerate. add undo. server unchanged. Tess: design nits: token pill contrast fails on white for small text. choose darker hue or use bold white text. ux-bot: checklist: live counter aria-hidden, final aria-live polite+atomic, visual update throttle 500ms, debounce finalize 300-500ms, queued-insert toast copy + undo, stop accessible name + tooltip, color contrast fix. Kira: i'll write a short interaction doc and attach figma once ready. assign spike to Noah to prototype throttle + queue handling. Noah: taking the spike. will report perf and reflow numbers in 48 hours. Kira: thanks all. will share figma link soon. :thumbsup:
